question: Select the synonym of **Reticent**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reserved**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Reticent"** refers to someone who is not readily revealing their thoughts or feelings; it means being restrained or keeping to oneself. (अल्पभाषी, शांत स्वभाव का)

 
 
• **Example:** The new employee was reticent during the meeting, preferring to observe rather than speak.
 
 
 
• **"Reserved"** is the synonym of "Reticent" as it also describes someone who is quiet and does not show emotions or opinions openly. (संकोची, आरक्षित)
 
 
• **Example:** She was a reserved individual who rarely shared her personal thoughts with others.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **'Reticent'** is **'Reserved'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Reserved**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Arrogant** (अहंकारी): Having an exaggerated sense of one’s own importance or abilities.

 
 
• **Example:** His arrogant attitude made it difficult for others to work with him.
 
 
 
• **Talkative** (बातूनी): Someone who talks a lot and enjoys engaging in conversations.
 
 
• **Example:** My cousin is so talkative that she can keep a conversation going for hours.
 
 
 
• **Outspoken** (स्पष्टवादी): Someone who expresses their opinions openly and honestly, even if it upsets others.
 
 
• **Example:** He is an outspoken critic of the government’s policies.
